## [1.12.5](https://github.com/0x11DFE/morphe-patches/compare/v1.12.4...v1.12.5) (2026-11-19)

### Bug Fixes

* shorten the Scene and Waypoint patch descriptions ([7e563b5](https://github.com/0x11DFE/morphe-patches/commit/7e563b575051e180b6bbdb5c135dbdf45479c729))

patches.name: Disable PairIP license check
patches.description: Empties com.pairip.licensecheck.LicenseClient.checkLicense so PairIP does not kill the re-signed APK. Works on any app that ships this class.

patches.name: Skip Waypoint onboarding paywall
patches.description: Skips the paywall after the tutorial: it runs the app's own free-choice handler (completeOnboarding, then home) and renders nothing. Fails cleanly when the bundle changes.

patches.name: Unlock Waypoint Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Waypoint Pro. The getCustomerInfo bridge and the hybridcommon mapper report a fake active lifetime entitlement (waypoint_lifetime), so it works even when api.revenuecat.com is unreachable.

patches.name: Daemon gate bypass
patches.description: Keeps the scene-daemon monitor gate open so live stats (dashboard cards, overlays) keep updating instead of freezing ~40s after connect. The daemon launcher script re-asserts the gate on every start and fails safe on unknown daemon layouts. Requires root.

patches.name: Random device ID
patches.description: Replaces the device SN with a random value everywhere the app uses it: user page, cloud sync and API calls to omarea. Baked per patch run. The daemon's own activation report is native and not affected.

patches.name: Unlock Scene N1
patches.description: Unlocks Scene N1 with a perpetual license and a configurable expiry date. The signature MD5 reported to omarea is spoofed to the original signing key, so re-signed builds still pass the activation binding.

options.description: Date the spoofed Scene N1 license expires, as yyyy-MM-dd. The app shows it on the user page; anything in the future keeps Pro active.

patches.name: Unlock optional features
patches.description: Shows the gated Optional features entries: Refresh rate, FAS in games and CPU limiters. The gates are cloud-profile and display-API checks, not device limits, so the features work locally. Bypass power supply stays hidden without a supported charging node.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Empties the banner, interstitial, rewarded and app-open ad loaders and the rewarded load in the server-row boost button. No ad request leaves the device. Use with 'Unlock Speed Boost' to keep the boost button working.

patches.name: Unlimited Time
patches.description: The session clock always reports 100 years, so sessions never expire. The countdown display shows the infinity sign.

patches.name: Unlock Speed Boost
patches.description: Grants the per-server boost on tap instead of after an interstitial. Same storage, rocket icon and toast as the ad flow. The 3-minute interstitial while connected is gone as well. Use together with 'Remove Ads'.
